name: agentic-development-skills
description: Agent Skills for agentic software development. Each skill is installable as its own plugin.

plugins.name: agent-harness-hook-runtime
plugins.description: Use when wiring agent hooks for Claude Code or OpenCode into a repo, writing a hook handler, or checking which hook events and capabilities the host supports.

plugins.name: agent-harness-hooked-rules
plugins.description: Use when writing, reviewing or onboarding hook-delivered rules in .agents/hooked-rules/, or when a rule file is invalid and the frontmatter grammar, pointer block or supported keys need explaining.

plugins.name: agent-harness-verify-gate
plugins.description: Use when running a repo's verify command on edit, on a ticked task and at turn end, or when onboarding or updating the verify gate in a repo.

plugins.name: feature-rfc
plugins.description: Write, review and amend a feature RFC: a system-level design with milestones and shared contracts, approved before the work is split into tasks, OpenSpec changes and PRs.

plugins.name: harness-audit
plugins.description: Read-only audit of a repository's agentic-coding harness (AGENTS.md, specs, verify command, hooks, permissions, sandbox, evals) that returns a prioritized TODO list.

plugins.name: milestone-breakdown
plugins.description: Split one milestone of an accepted feature RFC into PR-sized tasks for coding agents: slice vertically, size for review, handle gaps in the RFC, check dependencies and coverage, then keep the remaining tasks current after each merge and close the milestone.

plugins.name: project-conductor
plugins.description: Prepare a GitHub Project board and its repository for unattended task runs, and run one wake: start Ready tasks, handle phase reports and switch a task thread's model.

plugins.name: rfc-breakdown
plugins.description: Turn an accepted feature RFC into a backlog that covers all its milestones: full tasks only for the milestones that can start now, usually the first, outline tasks for the rest and a consistency check across milestones.

plugins.name: task-publishing
plugins.description: Publish the task files of a milestone or RFC breakdown to a tracker and keep it in step: a GitHub Project with issues, milestones, blocked-by links, sub-issues and Status, Phase and Area fields.

plugins.name: task-run
plugins.description: Use when a thread was started by the project-conductor with a start instruction or an apply instruction naming task-run: reconcile the task, plan by the repository's process, send the phase report, and after the model switch implement from the saved change folder through to the pull request.
